frysling.reason: No location on wiki; drops Frostcore (Deep North) and throws frost snowballs.

chicken.reason: Hatches from eggs, which come from Plains-tier progression (Fuling villages / Haldor after Yagluth).

Curious Axe Head.reason: Curious Axe Head wiki: can be found in a chest in an Abandoned House (Meadows); matches the compendium.

Mysterious Axe Head.reason: Mysterious Axe Head wiki: can be found in a chest in an Abandoned House (Meadows); matches the compendium.

Wisp.reason: Wisp wiki: collected from Wisp Fountains, which spawn in Mistlands.

Sharpening Stone.reason: Sharpening Stone wiki: crafted at a Stonecutter, which needs Iron (Swamp).

_notes.fish: Umbrella page of the fishing mechanic, not a creature.
_notes.hive / the-hive / riktig-fuling: Console-only creatures (wiki: 'can only be spawned via Console Commands').
_notes.spirit-caller / staff-of-the-wild: Weapons whose summons have creature infoboxes.
_notes.frost-blob: Only spawned by the player's Blob Bomb: Frost, not a natural creature.

Barber Kit.reason: Barber Kit and Hildir wiki: always available from Hildir in Meadows. Barber Station still needs Black Forest Finewood and Bronze Nails.

Iron Pit.reason: Iron Pit and Hildir wiki: always available from Hildir in Meadows.

Charcoal Resin.reason: Charcoal Resin drops from Scorched Tree; its wiki lists Ashlands.

Pot Shard.reason: Pot Shard wiki: Ancient Pots inside Putrid Holes or Charred Ruins in Ashlands.

Fir Cone.reason: Comfort wiki maximum section: both Maypole and Yule Tree require visiting Black Forest. Fir Cone lists growing biomes, not the earliest natural acquisition; use the early Fir route.

Pine Cone.reason: Pine wiki: naturally found in Black Forest. Growing biomes in the seed infobox do not determine acquisition tier.

Turnip.reason: Turnip wiki: seeds first found in Swamp. Preserve the existing Provisions item record and use its actual acquisition tier for Jack-O-Turnip.

bell-fragment.reason: Bell page: fragments in Charred Fortresses.

sealbreaker-fragment.reason: Sealbreaker page: fragments in Infested Mines.
